status: Exploratory analysis plan fixed before this script's trend/decomposition computations; not preregistered or blinded to earlier reports
cohort: 96 canonical conditions only; pilot pairs inventoried but never independent seeds
difficulty_observables: initial/intermediate full-pool MSE if actually retained
score_observables_not_equivalent_to_diff: source IQM of FP32 paired scores
secondary_common_horizon: maximum observed check at which all96 canonical runs are present; descriptive, not selected by effect size
trend_window: checks0..35; paired/trained trends start at check1; full observed coverage additionally retained
monotonicity: fraction and count of signed adjacent changes, reversals, OLS slopes and fraction below initial; no significance claim from endpoints
uncertainty: pointwise95% percentile bootstrap,10000 resamples of training seed labels; ten rounds are never seed replicates
domain_comparison: equal-task DMC(dog,humanoid) versus Myo(key,pen), within each architecture/seed/check;8 seed-label clusters; two tasks per domain are not population-level environment replication
score_decomposition: arithmetic round means for exact additive score-operand changes; retain source IQMs separately; do not assume IQM additivity
component_bounds: ideal-arithmetic b in[0,1] from sine range and nonnegative full-pool MSE; record FP32 qualification
near_zero_variance: b<=1e-12 gives undefined ratio(null plus flag), never an epsilon in the denominator
identification_witnesses: for common-window run/round trajectories, constant-b=.75 and feasible constant-fresh-MSE alternatives; algebraic feasibility only, not observed or certified teacher/optimization histories
associations: within-run Spearman and quadratic-time-residual Spearman on observed common-window points; metric as-of lag<=2000 interactions; actor returns only at exact coincident evaluations; no causal interpretation or repeated-point p-values
curve_inspection: pre-update changing-minibatch losses at0,100,500,1000; full-pool final at2000; never relabel the former as pool losses
precision: compute target-addition ULP bounds at actual retained offsets; no synthetic extreme values as campaign explanation; fixed-prediction bounds do not bound optimizer-trajectory effects
prohibited: invented checkpoints, targets or normalizer states
